decisions.name: 孫越
decisions.author: Rico Shen
decisions.reason: Original inspected: a single older man with both eyes visible behind tinted glasses; microphone stays below chin and does not obscure lips. Strong caption/name/category/Wikidata Q9041952 correspondence, but tinted lenses may make eyes-only reveal difficult. Actual 600x720 game crop, five stage visual check, photo SHA, work hint and attribution not yet approved. Pipeline 2026-10-31 confirmed the original can be downloaded and caption/CC metadata recognized, but 600x720 crop failed sharpness <65; reject source rather than weaken threshold. No five-stage approved crop. Other Commons award image was identity_unconfirmed.

decisions.name: 鳳小岳
decisions.author: 邱鈺鋒
decisions.reason: Actual original image shows a large rectangular microphone placard over lower face/mouth, making mouth-stage unreliable; cannot rescue by simple crop.

decisions.name: 王大陸

decisions.reason: Actual original shows opaque dark sunglasses covering eyes; eyes-first reveal cannot work even though portrait is high resolution and freely licensed.

nextActions: Do not retry the same Rico Shen source without a materially different original; find a sharp, front-facing, unoccluded, open-eyed photo for 孫越.
Do not infer person identity from the unverified historical award photo's search result.
Keep verified 《搭錯車》 role evidence from Hong Kong Film Archive for future hints; do not publish until photo, attribution, five-stage, SHA, branch and live QA pass.
